Aisha Khan: Heads-up: drafting a short customer RCA + enablement note for the onboarding wave hit by yesterday's ingest timeouts. Plan to send targeted to high-touch first. Draft in 25m, would love quick review. Main points: outage window, root cause, mitigation, backfill status, credits, office hours invite.

Marcos Rivera: One quick ask: add a one-line apology at top and a clear definition of impacted vs degraded for SLA language. Also include the formula for credits (overage fees during outage window).

Lena Chen: From SRE: root cause was a malformed protobuf that slipped past validators and caused worker retry loops -> queue backlog. Remediation: validation gate + rate-limited replay. I can paste a 1-2 sentence SRE blurb.

Aisha Khan: Please paste it in. Also confirm the exact UTC window so customers have dates.

Lena Chen: SRE blurb: "Root cause: a malformed protobuf message bypassed earlier validation, causing our ingest workers to repeatedly retry and back up onboarding queues. We deployed a schema-validation gate and rate-limited replays to restore throughput."

Jae Park: For renewal-risk customers (>$5k ARR in onboarding), recommend 1:1 outreach + offer a complimentary enablement session and 1 month waived ingestion overage. I'll upload the list in a minute.

Aisha Khan: Adding that: "If you were onboarding and experienced disruption, we'll schedule a dedicated enablement session and apply a credit for ingestion overages during the outage window."

Support Bot: IncidentBot: Incident #2026-INGEST-874 detected 2026-03-22T03:10:12Z, resolved 2026-03-22T03:48:09Z. Postmortem draft: https://redwood-internal/pg/INGEST-874/postmortem

Marcos Rivera: Draft opener idea for customers: "We're sorry — on March 22 at ~03:10 UTC some onboarding ingestion jobs were delayed. We've fixed the issue and completed replays; here's what happened and how we'll make it right." Then bullets: impact, actions, next steps, credits, contact. Keep it short.

Aisha Khan: Draft email below. Please flag edits by EOD. I'll send to high-touch list first, then broadcast to all affected tenants.

Aisha Khan: "Hi {{first_name}},
We're sorry — on March 22 between 03:10 and 03:48 UTC some onboarding ingestion jobs were delayed for a subset of customers due to a malformed message in our pipeline. We've fixed the root cause, completed backfills for critical onboarding flows, and added safeguards to prevent recurrence.
What we did:
• Blocked malformed protobufs with a schema validation gate.
• Rate-limited replays to avoid downstream spikes.
• Completed backfill for primary onboarding queues; if you still see missing records, open a ticket and we'll prioritize.
What you can expect:
• A dedicated enablement office hour for affected onboarding customers (links below).
• Ingestion overage fees incurred during the outage window will be credited. High-touch customers will also receive an additional one-month platform credit.
• Attached: technical RCA (internal link) and short FAQ.
If you'd like a 1:1 walkthrough, reply to this message and we'll schedule.
Sincerely,
Aisha Khan, Customer Success"

Lena Chen: LGTM. Add sentence: "We've added message schema checks upstream to reject malformed messages earlier in the pipeline."

Jae Park: Uploaded high-touch list: https://redwood-internal/drive/high-touch-onboard-3-22.csv. Use this for targeted outreach and mark any flagged renewal-risk customers for Sales follow-up.

Aisha Khan: Added the schema line and linked the list. Marcos can you confirm credit wording?

Marcos Rivera: Confirmed. Credit wording suggestion: "We will apply a credit equivalent to ingestion overage charges incurred during the outage window. For high-touch customers, we'll also provide an additional one-month credit for platform usage."

Aisha Khan: Final plan: send targeted emails in 30m, host two office hours (APAC slot + EMEA/AMER slot), attach short RCA, file customer copies on incident page, and ping Sales for renewal outreach. Thanks everyone :heart:

Support Bot: DeployBot: Schema-validation gate enabled at 2026-03-22T04:05:22Z. Playbook step complete.
